title: Recruiter/Talent Acquisition Specialist (Remote)
description:
Schedule : 9am - 5pm EST | Mon - Fri

Salary : $1,500 + $50m bonus

English Level : You must have C2 English to qualify

DO NOT APPLY UNLESS YOUR ENGLISH LEVEL IS ADVANCED


About US

Remotely+ connects growing U.S. companies with exceptional remote professionals throughout Latin America and the Caribbean.

We support our clients throughout the hiring process — from understanding their staffing needs and sourcing talent to screening, interviewing, selection, and onboarding. As we continue to grow, we're looking for a resourceful, technology-driven recruiter who can help us identify great talent quickly while maintaining a high-quality candidate and client experience.


About the Role

We’re looking for a Recruiter / Talent Acquisition Specialist with experience in staffing, BPO, or high-volume recruitment , including experience recruiting talent throughout Latin America , who thrives in a fast-moving environment.

This role requires an exceptionally high level of English proficiency, both written and spoken . You will be recruiting primarily for U.S.-based companies where English is the primary working language , so you must be fully comfortable conducting interviews, evaluating candidates’ English communication skills, writing professional candidate summaries, and communicating confidently with internal stakeholders and clients in English.


This is not a role where you’ll simply post jobs and review applications. You'll manage multiple searches simultaneously, actively source candidates, screen and assess talent, maintain organized recruiting pipelines, and partner closely with our internal team to ensure we’re consistently presenting strong candidates to our clients.


We’re especially interested in someone who knows how to use AI, recruiting technology, automation, ATS platforms (Zoho Recruit), and CRMs to work smarter and make recruiting processes more efficient. You should also be able to identify bottlenecks throughout the recruitment process and recommend practical ways to improve efficiency, candidate flow, and overall hiring outcomes.

Because Remotely+ is growing, you'll also have the opportunity to help us improve, build, and refine recruiting processes as we scale.


What You'll Do

  • Manage multiple recruiting searches simultaneously across different industries and job functions.
  • Source candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, databases, referrals, social media, and creative sourcing strategies.
  • Review and screen high volumes of applications efficiently while maintaining strong hiring standards.
  • Conduct initial candidate interviews and assess experience, communication skills, English proficiency, professionalism, and overall fit.
  • Evaluate candidates against client requirements and identify the strongest profiles to move forward.
  • Prepare candidate summaries, recruiter notes, and recommendations for internal and client review.
  • Maintain accurate candidate records, stages, notes, communications, and activity within the ATS.
  • Proactively build talent pipelines for frequently hired and hard-to-fill positions.
  • Communicate with candidates throughout the recruitment process and provide a positive, responsive candidate experience.
  • Identify bottlenecks in the recruitment process and recommend ways to improve efficiency.
  • Help develop recruiting templates, screening processes, interview guides, assessments, workflows, and standard operating procedures as the company scales.
  • Use AI and automation tools to increase productivity while maintaining human judgment and high recruiting standards.


What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of recruiting or talent acquisition experience , ideally within staffing, BPO, recruitment agencies, outsourcing, or other high-volume hiring environments.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.
  • Proven experience managing multiple roles and large candidate pipelines at the same time .
  • Experience recruiting talent throughout Latin America .
  • ATS experience is a must and familiarity with Zoho Recruit as an ATS is a huge plus.
  • Experience working in a staffing or recruitment agency environment.
  • Experience recruiting for a variety of positions and adapting quickly to unfamiliar industries or job functions.
  • Strong interviewing and candidate assessment skills.
  • Ability to quickly identify whether a candidate truly meets the core requirements of a position.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to prioritize effectively and work independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Comfortable working with recruiting metrics and using data to improve sourcing and hiring decisions.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.

title: Business Development & Marketing
description:

In Brazil and Latin America, we are building partnerships with leading media, telecom, digital platforms and brands to make Asian entertainment more accessible to local audiences.


Role purpose

Support iQIYI’s expansion in Brazil and Latin America by prospecting, developing and coordinating commercial and marketing partnerships. The role requires the ability to independently organize priorities, lead meetings, prepare proposals, follow up on opportunities and coordinate projects with external partners and internal teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia, without constant supervision.


Key responsibilities

1. Business Development & Partnerships – approximately 70%

  • Map, prospect and develop relationships with private and public free-to-air broadcasters, telecommunications operators, digital and OTT platforms, distributors, technology companies, payment providers, retailers, consumer brands and other strategic partners.
  • Build and maintain an organized pipeline of potential partners in Brazil and other Latin American markets, documenting contacts, opportunity stages, next steps, risks and timelines.
  • Prepare presentations, commercial proposals, preliminary partnership models, meeting minutes, progress reports and decision-support materials.
  • Lead initial meetings, identify partner needs and develop value propositions suited to different cooperation models.
  • Support negotiations involving content distribution, licensing, revenue sharing, subscription bundles, media/barter, co-marketing, customer benefits, promotions and other commercial models.

    final approvals and signatures remain with management and headquarters.
  • Coordinate the progress of opportunities with internal content, marketing, product, technology, legal, finance, operations and other teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia.
  • Support partnership implementation after approval, ensuring alignment on scope, deliverables, timelines and performance indicators.
  • Conduct research on markets, competitors, potential partners and trends across streaming, television, telecommunications and entertainment in Latin America.
  • Represent iQIYI in partner meetings, industry events and business visits, with availability for occasional travel within Brazil and Latin America.

2. Marketing Partnerships – approximately 30%

  • Identify and structure marketing opportunities with commercial partners to promote the iQIYI brand, priority content launches and subscription offers.
  • Plan and coordinate co-marketing initiatives, partner campaigns, events, activations, content promotion and online/offline promotional projects.
  • Adapt global briefs and materials to the needs of Brazil and other Latin American markets, ensuring local relevance and compliance with brand guidelines.
  • Coordinate deliverables with internal and external stakeholders, including partners, agencies, public relations teams, influencers and vendors when applicable.
  • Track execution and results, gather evidence of delivery and prepare reports with learnings and recommendations.



Required qualifications

  • At least 3 years of experience in business development, partnerships, commercial roles, partnership marketing or related functions.
  • Hands-on experience in B2B prospecting, relationship management, proposal preparation and follow-up of negotiations or partner projects.
  • Fluent or native Portuguese.

  • Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, set priorities, meet deadlines and keep stakeholders informed.
  • Strong verbal and written communication, negotiation, organization and relationship-building skills.

Preferred qualifications

title: Corporate Travel Agent

- Knowledge of ARC (USA) and or IATA BSP accounting process is a plus


Why Join Us

- Engage with high-profile clients and premium travel partners.

- Be part of a collaborative, growth-oriented culture.

- Enjoy a remote-first setup with flexible work arrangements


bTd Travel Culture:

At bTd, we are passionate about travel, bridging distances, connecting worlds, and creating unique experiences for our clients. We foster a culture that embodies entrepreneurship, hands-on collaboration, and teamwork. Our flexible work environment supports work-life balance, eliminating commuting time and offering opportunities for relocation or nomadic work. We are driven by a global mindset, a passion for client success, and a strong focus on results. Our environment values risk-taking, leadership development, and learning by doing, providing multiple opportunities for personal and professional growth. We respect diversity at all levels and embrace meritocracy, rewarding high performance and ensuring no space for toxic behavior or poor performance.

bTd is committed to corporate governance, ethics, and mutual trust, building confidence through facts and evidence rather than perceptions. We promote an open, friendly, and respectful atmosphere where differences and preferences are honored. Join us and grow alongside bTd, with the opportunity to become part of the company’s evolution and stakes.

  • Food card.
  • Birthday day off.
  • Opportunity for professional growth, with the potential to be promoted to Head of Corporate Globally as bTd evolves through its funding rounds.

Important Note Before Applying:

Let’s keep it real! Apply only if you meet at least 80% of the qualifications and can prove it with your LinkedIn profile or updated resume . We’re not looking for someone who just "gets it" — we need a self-starter ready to deliver results from day one .

title: Regional Sales Representative
description:
SC — Regional Sales Representative

Quectel | LATAM | Sales & Business Development


Position Details

Job Title: SC — Regional Sales Representative

Department: Sales & Business Development — LATAM

Reports To: Regional Sales Manager / Director, LATAM

Location: Santa Catarina, Brazil

Work Arrangement: Hybrid — with regular field visits across the assigned territory

Employment Type: Full-Time

Travel Required: Frequent travel across Santa Catarina and the LATAM region (customer visits, trade shows)


Role Overview

The SC — Regional Sales Representative will be a key growth driver for Quectel LATAM, responsible for maximizing Quectel's market share in the region on Non-Cellular product lines (e.G., GNSS, Wi-Fi & Bluetooth, satellite communication, antennas) and new market segments. This will be achieved through a dedicated focus on market analysis and by winning new verticals and customers centered on these product lines.

Acting as the face of Quectel in Santa Catarina, this professional will map and develop the full commercial potential of the territory — prospecting new customers, engaging underserved segments, and ensuring that every technology company in the region knows Quectel and its affiliate solutions.


Key Responsibilities

  • Understand the needs and expectations of customers and provide relevant, solution-oriented recommendations.
  • Prospect every new customer who uses any technology solutions within the assigned territory.
  • Maintain a high volume of client and partner engagement, ensuring a minimum of 10 meetings per week while sustaining consistent productivity standards.
  • Map and develop the full commercial potential of the assigned territory — going beyond well-known business clusters to identify and engage new client prospects and underserved market segments.
  • Follow up on account designs for the assigned product lines within the Regional Funnel.
  • Train the Quectel Sales Force and Rep Firms/Distributors on the assigned product lines and follow up on resulting opportunities.
  • Create a Monthly Territory Discussion Report covering leads, technical evaluations, meeting plans, roadmap calls, and related activities.
  • Operate CRM (customer relationship management) systems and ensure authentic, up-to-date information is available within the company.
  • Visit exhibitor booths at trade shows to identify accounts and products that use cellular modules and obtain contact information.
  • Ensure 100% of technology customers in the region/state get to know Quectel and its affiliate solutions.


Qualifications & Requirements

Required

  • Experience: Minimum of 3 years in sales positions within the IoT segment.
  • Educational Background: Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, Automation, Electronics & Communication, or other IT-related fields.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Portuguese and English.
  • Customer-Centric: Demonstrated ability to understand and align solutions with customer business goals.
  • Location: Based in Santa Catarina, Brazil, with availability for frequent travel across the territory.


Preferred

  • Knowledge of non-cellular technologies such as GNSS, Wi-Fi & Bluetooth, LoRa, satellite communication, and antennas.
  • Existing relationships with OEMs, design houses, system integrators, or distributors in Southern Brazil.
  • Experience selling into smart metering, asset tracking, smart agriculture, industrial IoT, or connected mobility verticals.
  • Proficiency with CRM tools (e.G., Salesforce, HubSpot) and standard productivity software.
  • Spanish language skills a plus.


About Quectel

Quectel is a global IoT solutions provider and the world's leading supplier of cellular and GNSS modules, with a mission to build a smarter world. Our broad portfolio spans cellular modules (5G, LTE, LPWA), GNSS, Wi-Fi & Bluetooth and satellite communication modules, antennas, and IoT connectivity services — combined with outstanding support and services that shorten our customers' time-to-market.


With engineering, sales, and support teams across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM, Quectel serves a rapidly growing base of IoT innovators worldwide. Together with ecosystem affiliates such as Acceleronix (IoT platform and Connectivity-as-a-Service), Quectel enables end-to-end solutions from module to cloud.


Life at Quectel LATAM

At Quectel LATAM, no two days are the same. You'll collaborate with a diverse, globally-connected team, engage directly with some of the most innovative OEMs and enterprises in Latin America, and contribute to technologies that are redefining how devices and people connect.


  • Fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment backed by the resources of the global leader in IoT modules.
  • Direct access to global R&D, product, and engineering teams across Asia, Europe, and the Americas.
  • Regular knowledge-sharing through internal trainings, webinars, and cross-functional project teams.
  • A culture of continuous learning — we invest in your growth because your development is our development.


Industries & Applications

Quectel's IoT solutions power innovation across a wide range of industries. As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact in:


  • Smart Metering & Utilities — Electricity, water, and gas metering solutions.
  • Asset Tracking & Logistics — Fleet management, cold chain, and supply chain visibility.
  • Smart Agriculture — Precision farming, greenhouse monitoring, and livestock tracking.
  • Smart Cities & Infrastructure — Street lighting, parking, public safety, environmental monitoring.
  • Industrial IoT & Automation — Predictive maintenance, factory automation, condition monitoring.
  • Connected Mobility & Automotive — Telematics, EV charging, micro-mobility.
  • Smart Home & Consumer IoT — Connected appliances, energy management, security.


Why Quectel LATAM?

  • Global Impact, Regional Focus — Be at the forefront of IoT innovation across Latin America, backed by the global market leader with teams in APAC, EMEA, and North America.
  • Career Growth & Development — Access structured mentorship, international exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths within a fast-growing global organization.
  • Cutting-Edge Technology — Work with next-generation GNSS, Wi-Fi & Bluetooth, satellite, antenna, and cellular technologies deployed in mission-critical applications.
  • Diversity & Inclusion — Join an inclusive, multicultural workplace where diverse perspectives are valued as key drivers of innovation and success.
  • Global Team & Collaboration — Collaborate with a global network of IoT experts across engineering, sales, marketing, and operations — and with the Quectel ecosystem, including Acceleronix.


Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks.
  • Performance bonus / sales commission structure.
  • Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance).
  • Health insurance with no co-pay.
  • Life insurance.
  • Paid time off.
  • International travel opportunities (HQ visits, global trade shows).


Explore Quectel — Links & Resources

We encourage all candidates to learn more about Quectel before applying. The links below will give you a full picture of who we are, what we build, and what it's like to work here.

Company & Careers

title: Representante Técnico(A) De Vendas
description:
Faça parte da ICL:

Na ICL, acreditamos que a inovação começa com pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem. Somos uma empresa global de soluções em especialidades, com presença em mais de 30 países e impacto em setores essenciais como agricultura, alimentos e materiais industriais.

Como líder mundial na fabricação de fertilizantes de eficiência aprimorada, oferecemos aos agricultores e à indústria soluções avançadas para uma agricultura de alto desempenho, incluindo produtos especiais de alta qualidade para diferentes necessidades. Nosso trabalho contribui para aumentar a produtividade, a rentabilidade e a qualidade de vida das pessoas.

No Brasil, nossa trajetória é marcada por crescimento sustentável, compromisso com a inovação e respeito às comunidades onde atuamos. Com unidades em diversas regiões do país, temos orgulho de impulsionar o desenvolvimento da agricultura brasileira, promovendo práticas mais eficientes e sustentáveis.


Nossa missão:

Gerar impacto positivo no mundo dos alimentos, agricultura e produtos industriais, avançando para um futuro sustentável para toda a humanidade.

Como fazemos isso:

Unimos nossos recursos naturais, a dedicação de uma equipe talentosa e nossa capacidade tecnológica para ampliar a produção de alimentos, garantir sua qualidade, viabilizar uma agricultura e uma produção industrial sustentáveis e proteger o meio ambiente.

Nossos princípios:

  • Inovação: Criada por pessoas apaixonadas, apoiada por infraestrutura de P&D e parcerias estratégicas, formando um ecossistema único.
  • Cuidado: Fazer o que é certo para nossos colaboradores, parceiros de negócios, acionistas, comunidades e meio ambiente.
  • Liderança: Atuar como referência em inovação, gestão de custos e sustentabilidade, com mentalidade orientada a resultados e espírito vencedor.


Vaga: RTV

Região: SE/AL/BA

Modalidade : PJ


Atividades:

  • Prospecção de clientes finais e distribuidores;
  • Realização de vendas e desenvolvimento a campo do portfólio da empresa;
  • Treinamento de canais de venda e assistência técnica, garantindo o suporte necessário para o crescimento dos negócios.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Agronomia;
  • Conhecimento emnutrição de plantas e fertilidade de solo (desejável);
  • Familiaridade com a região de atuação, proporcionando um atendimento eficaz e personalizado aos clientes.


Na ICL, acreditamos que a diversidade é o motor da inovação. Por isso, todas as nossas vagas são elegíveis para as pessoas independentemente de raça, gênero, deficiência, orientação sexual ou qualquer outra característica. Embora esta posição não seja afirmativa/exclusiva, reforçamos que todas as pessoas são bem-vindas a se candidatar. Valorizamos diferentes perspectivas e experiências e ficaremos felizes em receber sua candidatura!

#LGBTQIA+ #PessoasNegras #PcD #50+ #Gerações #PessoasComDeficiência

Buscamos pessoas que gostem de desafios;

Se identificou? Então, vem fazer parte do time #SangueLaranja

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Talent Acquisition Specialist (Confidential)

Location: Alphaville, São Paulo, Brazil

Work Arrangement: Hybrid (2 days per week on-site)


About the Opportunity

A leading multinational organization, is seeking a Talent Acquisition Specialist to support hiring activities across Brazil and other Latin American markets. This role will partner closely with business leaders and HR stakeholders to identify, attract, and hire top talent across a variety of functions and organizational levels.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage full-cycle recruitment processes from intake through offer and onboarding.
  • Partner with hiring managers and HR Business Partners to develop effective sourcing and hiring strategies.
  • Lead recruitment efforts across a broad range of functions, including Manufacturing, Technical, Engineering, Commercial, Corporate, and Shared Services roles.
  • Recruit for positions across multiple organizational levels, from individual contributors to senior leadership roles.
  • Support hiring needs across Brazil and other countries in Latin America.
  • Build and maintain diverse talent pipelines to meet current and future business needs.
  • Deliver an exceptional candidate and hiring manager experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle.
  • Utilize market intelligence and talent insights to influence hiring decisions and workforce planning.
  • Ensure accurate and compliant management of recruitment activities within the Applicant Tracking System.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of Talent Acquisition experience , preferably within a multinational organization.
  • Proven experience recruiting across multiple functions, including manufacturing, technical, commercial, and corporate roles.
  • Experience hiring for various organizational levels, from entry-level and professional positions to management and senior leadership roles.
  • Experience supporting recruitment across multiple countries within Latin America.
  • Proficiency with Applicant Tracking Systems;
    Workday experience is strongly preferred .
  • Advanced English proficiency is required ;
    Spanish is a plus.
  • Strong stakeholder management, consulting, and influencing skills.

Preferred Competencies

  • Strong sourcing, talent mapping, and market research capabilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple requisitions simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
  • Data-driven mindset with strong attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to work effectively across diverse cultures, teams, and geographies.


This is an excellent opportunity for a Talent Acquisition professional who thrives in a dynamic, multinational environment and enjoys recruiting top talent across a diverse range of functions, levels, and countries throughout Latin America.

description:

  • Apoiar e desenvolver os integrantes da equipe;

Buscamos alguém que consiga gerenciar sem perder a visão da operação .

A pessoa ideal entende o processo de locação de ponta a ponta, consegue identificar rapidamente quando algo está fora do padrão e sabe orientar a equipe sobre como resolver.

É necessário ter capacidade para priorizar demandas, tomar decisões, cobrar resultados, organizar processos e desenvolver pessoas , mantendo uma comunicação profissional com proprietários, inquilinos e equipe interna.

Também esperamos alguém que tenha autonomia para resolver grande parte das situações do dia a dia e saiba identificar quando uma decisão precisa ser escalada para a direção.

title: Finance Manager
description:
When you join GAR, you join something bigger. Big in scale, big in opportunities to grow, and big in impact. With over 100,000 employees across 14 countries, spanning Asia, Europe, North America, and South America, Golden Agri-Resources (GAR) is one of the largest agribusinesses in the world. We manage over half a million hectares of palm oil plantations, including smallholder farms, across Indonesia. But our size is only part of the story. Since 1997, we’ve put sustainability at the centre of how we grow, working hand-in-hand with farmers, communities, and partners to deliver food, fuel, and a better future.

We’re a seed-to-shelf business rooted in palm oil, now expanding across other essential crops like sugar, soybean, sunflower, and coconut.

Our people are our edge. We invest in them through global opportunities, cross-border exposure, and continuous learning, because growing a better business starts with growing our people.

Here, your career feeds something meaningful for the planet, people, and generations to come


We are looking for an experienced Finance Manager to join our team in São Paulo, Brazil. In this role, you will oversee all aspects of finance, accounting, tax, legal, IT, and treasury, including financial reporting, budgeting, taxation, cash management, and statutory compliance. You will be responsible for maintaining the full set of ledgers and accounts, managing monthly closing activities, preparing financial and statutory reports, ensuring compliance with applicable local, international, and internal accounting and tax standards, and supporting the timely and accurate consolidation of financial information for Head Office. As a business partner, you will provide data-driven insights to support decision-making and play a key role in building systems, processes, and frameworks from scratch, particularly across finance, tax, legal, and treasury. This is a highly hands-on role, especially during the initial phase, requiring you to personally execute and/or review key finance processes such as payments, bank reconciliations, tax calculations, invoicing, accounting entries, and month-end closing. We are looking for someone who is proactive, improvement-oriented, and solution-driven, with strong analytical and organizational skills, excellent communication abilities, and a collaborative mindset. The ideal candidate will also have the ability to lead, motivate, and develop teams while working effectively in a dynamic and growing environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain all accounting records in the ERP system to ensure accuracy of the general ledger and financial accounts.
  • Lead the monthly and annual financial closing processes through the preparation of standard reports as well as other custom reports as requested.
  • Review and analyse financial statements/records and provide reports and data analysis to various internal stakeholders.
  • Manage day-to-day risk exposures, -reports and -mitigation measures such as insurances, hedges etc. Work with credit team to manage counterpart exposures and follow up on overdue receivables.
  • Ensure adequate liquidity to support the business, support/investigate/expand local or central funding opportunities.
  • Lead the transition of the bookkeeping from external service providers to "in-house".
  • Ensure desired IT platform and relevant key procedures will be implemented.
  • Coordinate and assist finance department in Brazil with the financial record keeping of the activities undertaken in Brazil.
  • Oversee local administrative matters and purchase office supplies and equipment while maintaining appropriate stock levels in a cost-efficient manner.
  • Manage and execute all payments and customer invoicing, including entering payment instructions into the online banking system and coordinating the required approvals to ensure payments are released accurately and within the established deadlines.
  • Prepare and process cash claims and expense reimbursements for the Brazilian team.
  • Advise and assist various departments on accounting, tax and legal compliance by researching and ensuring compliance to applicable internal, national and international rules and regulations.
  • Coordinate external / internal audits and prepare audit requirements.
  • Liaise with central teams in Singapore / Jakarta for ad-hoc queries and analysis requests.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for office managers, IT teams, auditors, accountants, finance managers, and HR teams across other locations in the EU and Americas regions.
  • Act as the first point of contact for external stakeholders such as banks, legal, tax authorities and other regulatory bodies, service providers.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • 8+ years’ relevant experience in accounting, finance and trade control
  • Strong knowledge of Brazilian and international accounting, tax and regulatory requirements.
  • Working experience in the Commodity industry
  • Experience with tax, legal, banking
  • Experience with implementing IT systems and consolidation work
  • Proficient with MS Office
  • Experience with ERP software (SAP is an advantage)
  • Experience working in an international environment
  • Experience building & leading a high performing team
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken
  • Fluent in Spanish, both written and spoken is preferred

We Offer

  • An entrepreneurial and international environment where developing opportunities for growth is valued
  • Training opportunities, locally and globally
  • Health insurance
  • Meal support (vale refeição)
  • Transport support/Parking lot (Vale transporte ou vaga de estacionamento)


Please note that we may incorporate an assessment and reference checks in our selection procedures.

title: Overseas Pre-Sales Engineer-Brazil
description:
Responsibility：

Solution Development and Customization：

  • Communicate deeply with customers (commercial enterprises, industrial customers, agricultural cooperatives or government agencies) to evaluate their energy needs (such as cost reduction, renewable energy integration or grid stability).
  • Work with internal technical teams to design and propose customized solutions, such as 1 MW to 3 MW photovoltaic systems, battery backup (BESS) or hybrid energy projects.
  • Integrate photovoltaic, energy storage or other technologies according to the customer's specific application scenarios (such as peak shaving, off-grid power supply or frequency regulation services) to ensure the absorption and competitiveness of the solution.

Sales and Business Development：

  • Develop and implement solutions sales strategies to achieve company revenue targets, especially in the fast-growing distributed PV and energy storage market in Brazil.
  • Identify potential customers and sales opportunities, and proactively promote company products and services, such as solutions for the southeast region with high electricity prices or the northeast region with abundant solar resources.
  • Convert potential customers into actual orders by demonstrating technical advantages and return on investment (ROI).

Bridging technology and business

  • Explain the technical details of the solution to customers (such as PV system efficiency, energy storage discharge time) and translate them into business language (cost savings, revenue improvement).
  • Prepare and present professional sales proposals, including technical specifications, financial models (such as payback period calculation) and project benefit analysis.
  • Submit high-quality proposals on behalf of the company and participate in negotiations in bidding or competition (such as the 2025 energy storage auction).

Customer Relationship and After-Sales Support

  • Serve as the customer's primary contact to ensure smooth progress from solution design to project delivery, and provide technical consultation and support.
  • Follow up the progress of project implementation, coordinate with the engineering team, and solve problems that arise during installation or operation.
  • Provide after-sales service suggestions (such as system upgrades, maintenance plans) to promote long-term cooperation and upsell.

Market Analysis and Product Feedback

  • Monitor Brazilian energy market trends, such as policy changes (Law 14.300, ANEEL Energy Storage Specifications), competitor dynamics, and customer demand changes.
  • Collect customer feedback and work with product development teams to optimize solutions (such as increasing storage capacity or reducing costs).
  • Report market insights to management regularly and recommend new product or service directions.

Cross-departmental collaboration

  • Work closely with the technical team to ensure that the solution complies with Brazilian grid standards (such as ONS requirements) and customer expectations.
  • Coordinate with the finance department to provide financing options (such as BNDES loans or installments) to help customers overcome financial barriers.
  • Liaise with procurement and supply chain teams to ensure timely delivery of equipment (such as PV modules, batteries).

Training and knowledge sharing

  • Provide technical training to sales teams or customers to explain the working principles and advantages of photovoltaic and energy storage systems.
  • Participate in industry events (such as energy exhibitions) to showcase company solutions and build brand influence.


Requirement：

Preferred:

  • Direct experience in the field of photovoltaics or energy storage, such as selling 1 MW to 3 MW photovoltaic systems or battery energy storage solutions.
  • Participation in project development in the Brazilian market, such as distributed generation or grid integration projects.

title: Consultor Financeiro
description:
CONSULTOR(A) FINANCEIRO(A) — LANCE CONSÓRCIOSobre o cargo

A Lance Consórcio busca profissionais com perfil comercial, ambição e vontade de crescer para fazer parte do nosso time como Consultor(a) Financeiro(a) .

O profissional atuará diretamente no atendimento e relacionamento com clientes, entendendo seus objetivos financeiros e patrimoniais e apresentando soluções de crédito e consórcio de forma estratégica e personalizada.

Atualmente, nosso principal foco comercial é a comercialização de cartas de crédito contempladas , oferecendo ao cliente uma alternativa de crédito de baixo custo financeiro para diferentes objetivos, como tracionar negócios, impulsionar empresas, realizar alavancagem patrimonial, alavancagem financeira e viabilizar aquisições estratégicas .

Além das cartas contempladas, o consultor também terá a oportunidade de trabalhar com cotas novas de consórcio , ampliando seu portfólio de soluções e suas possibilidades de negócio.

Você não começa do zero

Um dos grandes diferenciais da Lance Consórcio é que o consultor não precisa construir sua operação do zero .

A empresa disponibiliza:

  • Carteira de clientes e contatos para trabalho ;
  • Treinamentos completos sobre produtos e soluções;
  • Capacitação comercial e desenvolvimento profissional;
  • Assessoria durante os atendimentos e negociações;
  • Suporte da equipe comercial;
  • Participação emreuniões e acompanhamentos;
  • Materiais de apoio para o desenvolvimento das vendas;
  • Estrutura para que o profissional possa desenvolver sua carteira e seus resultados.

Por isso, não buscamos necessariamente profissionais que já dominem o mercado de consórcios. Buscamos pessoas com vontade de aprender, perfil comercial, boa comunicação, capacidade de negociação e, principalmente, vontade de crescer.

Principais responsabilidades
  • Realizar atendimento consultivo a clientes e potenciais clientes;
  • Trabalhar a carteira de clientes disponibilizada pela empresa;
  • Realizar prospecção e desenvolver novas oportunidades;
  • Identificar o perfil, momento e objetivos financeiros de cada cliente;
  • Apresentar soluções de crédito e consórcio de forma personalizada;
  • Atuar principalmente na comercialização de cartas de crédito contempladas ;
  • Trabalhar também com cotas novas de consórcio ;
  • Elaborar propostas comerciais;
  • Conduzir reuniões e apresentações;
  • Negociar e acompanhar oportunidades até a conclusão da venda;
  • Manter relacionamento com clientes e buscar indicações;
  • Registrar atendimentos e oportunidades nos sistemas internos;
  • Acompanhar metas, indicadores e resultados individuais;
  • Participar de treinamentos, reuniões e atividades de desenvolvimento comercial.
Perfil que buscamos

Procuramos profissionais que tenham:

  • Perfil proativo e empreendedor ;
  • Comunicação clara e persuasiva;
  • Poder de negociação;
  • Foco em metas eresultados;
  • Ambição profissional;
  • Facilidade paracriar e desenvolver relacionamentos;
  • Boa postura profissional;
  • Organização e comprometimento;
  • Vontade de aprender e se desenvolver;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe;
  • Energia e disposição para atuar em um ambiente comercial dinâmico.
Não é necessário saber tudo sobre consórcio.

Se você possui boa comunicação, capacidade de relacionamento, vontade de aprender e ambição para crescer , nós fornecemos o treinamento, o conhecimento dos produtos, a estrutura e o suporte necessários para você desenvolver sua atuação.

Qualificações
  • Experiência com vendas, atendimento comercial ou relacionamento com clientes será considerada um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento ouinteresse em finanças, crédito, planejamento financeiro ou organização patrimonial;
  • Boa comunicaçãoverbal e escrita;
  • Habilidade de negociação e argumentação;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas digitais e sistemas de atendimento/CRM;
  • Disponibilidadepara atuação presencial;
  • Ensino médio completo.
Diferenciais
  • Experiência no mercado de consórcios;
  • Experiência comprodutos financeiros ou crédito;
  • Experiência comvendas consultivas e de alto ticket;
  • Possuir uma boarede de contatos;
  • Possuir carteira ou histórico de relacionamento com clientes;
  • Experiência comercial em áreas como vendas, seguros, crédito, imóveis, veículos ou serviços financeiros.
O que oferecemos
  • Altas comissões ;
  • Ajuda de custo;
  • Premiações mensais;
  • Carteira de clientes para trabalho;
  • Treinamentos constantes;
  • Desenvolvimentoe crescimento profissional;
  • Suporte comercial e acompanhamento;
  • Materiais de apoio;
  • Ambiente comercial dinâmico e motivador;
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Reconhecimento interno;
  • Estrutura e suporte para desenvolvimento da carreira.
Quem é a Lance Consórcio?

Somos uma empresa focada em soluções de crédito e estratégias de alavancagem financeira e patrimonial , utilizando o consórcio como ferramenta para ajudar nossos clientes a alcançarem seus objetivos.

Aqui, o consultor não trabalha apenas com a venda de um produto. Nosso objetivo é entender o momento do cliente e apresentar estratégias de crédito que façam sentido para seus objetivos pessoais, profissionais e patrimoniais .

Se você é uma pessoa ambiciosa, comunicativa, proativa, gosta de desafios e quer construir uma carreira comercial com alto potencial de ganhos , queremos conhecer você.

Venha fazer parte da Lance Consórcio.

title: Private Wealth Advisor
description:
Company Description


Garavello Capital helps individuals and families protect what they have built and plan confidently for the future. Headquartered in the United States, the firm specializes in asset protection, retirement planning, and college planning. Advisors design tailored strategies aligned with each client’s unique goals, priorities, and risk profile. The company rejects one-size-fits-all approaches, instead focusing on solutions informed by a deep understanding of client needs, timelines, and vision. Team members collaborate closely with clients to deliver long-term, holistic wealth and protection strategies.


Role Description


The Private Wealth Advisor is a full-time, remote role responsible for providing comprehensive financial guidance to individuals and families. Day-to-day activities include meeting with clients virtually, assessing financial situations, and developing personalized plans for asset protection, retirement, estate, and education funding. The advisor will analyze investment options, explain complex financial concepts in accessible terms, and monitor client portfolios to ensure alignment with changing goals and market conditions. The role involves building and maintaining long-term client relationships, preparing clear recommendations and reports, and collaborating with internal partners where needed. The advisor will also stay current on financial planning best practices and industry trends to deliver informed, ethical advice.


Qualifications


  • Strong financial planning skills, including experience in holistic Financial Planning and Retirement Planning;

  • Knowledge of Investments, including portfolio construction, risk management, and long-term wealth accumulation strategies.
  • Experience in Estate Planning and asset protection, with the ability to coordinate strategies with legal and tax professionals.
  • Business Relationship Management skills, with a track record of building trust, managing client expectations, and delivering high-quality service.
  • Relevant bachelor’s degree (e.G., Finance, Economics, Business) or equivalent professional experience.
  • Excellent communication and presentation abilities, with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Comfort working independently in a remote environment, with high integrity and adherence to regulatory and ethical standards.

title: Consultor De Campo – São Paulo
description:
Local : São Paulo e região (viagens regulares)

Tipo de contratação : Autônomo, com possibilidade de conversão para CLT (efetivo)

Remuneração : Valor fixo mensal mais variável por performance

🚘 A Hub cobre combustível, quilometragem e despesas de viagem para o atendimento em campo


Sobre a Hub

A Hub é uma empresa de dados do mundo real. A IA e os robôs aprendem como as pessoas realmente vivem a partir de dados que não existem na internet: como as pessoas se movem, usam as mãos e realizam tarefas do dia a dia. Pessoas reais capturam esses dados usando um celular preso a um suporte de cabeça, e a Hub transforma isso nos dados de treinamento que os principais laboratórios de IA e empresas de robótica utilizam. A Hub é apoiada pela Y Combinator e tem sede em Palo Alto, na Califórnia. Nossa operação no Brasil está baseada em São Paulo e crescendo rápido.


Sobre a vaga

Estamos contratando um Consultor de Campo para gerenciar a operação da Hub em São Paulo. Colaboradores e empresas locais da região registram dados para a Hub todos os dias como parte das nossas operações. Essa pessoa será responsável por manter essa operação funcionando de ponta a ponta: coordenando a instalação de equipamentos, verificando a produção e resolvendo problemas operacionais no local.


É uma posição prática, de campo. A maior parte do trabalho acontece nas pequenas e médias empresas pela grande São Paulo e cidades vizinhas, não numa mesa, então viagens locais frequentes são parte essencial da função.


O que você vai fazer

  • Gerenciar o ciclo completo de cada empresa da sua região: receber uma empresa recém fechada, preparar e conferir cada kit de equipamento, instalar no local, treinar os trabalhadores do local, verificar as primeiras gravações aceitas e levar cada local a uma produção semanal estável.
  • Garantir que cada dispositivo instalado esteja ativo e gravando, e resolver os que não estiverem.
  • Resolver problemas no local, desde conectividade de internet até questões de equipamento e dúvidas sobre o fluxo de trabalho.
  • Manter registros precisos de cada local, visita e follow up num CRM.
  • Reativar locais parados e restaurar a produção.
  • Identificar e indicar novas oportunidades de negócio na sua região, mediante aprovação do seu gestor.


Indicadores de performance

  • Tempo entre o fechamento do local e a instalação completa
  • Tempo entre a instalação e a primeira hora de gravação verificada
  • Porcentagem de dispositivos instalados gravando ativamente a cada semana
  • Horas de gravação verificadas por semana em cada local
  • Taxa de recuperação de locais parados


✅ Requisitos

  • Português fluente e inglês básico.
  • Disponível para trabalhar presencialmente na grande região de São Paulo.
  • CNH válida e acesso confiável a um veículo para o trabalho de campo diário.
  • Abordagem autônoma e orientada a processos para gerenciar tarefas operacionais com pouca supervisão.
  • Experiência usando um CRM ou ferramenta de acompanhamento similar, ou capacidade de aprender rápido.
  • Fortes habilidades interpessoais e capacidade de construir relações profissionais com donos de negócios pessoalmente.
  • Pelo menos um ano de experiência profissional relevante.


🚀 Oportunidade de crescimento

Essa vaga tem um caminho de crescimento definido. Começando na prática, com as operações do dia a dia, o Consultor de Campo que constrói e documenta um processo eficaz e repetível pode crescer para liderar as operações de campo da Hub em várias cidades e estados do Brasil.


A Hub é uma empresa que oferece oportunidades iguais. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados para a vaga sem distinção de idade, raça, cor, religião, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, origem nacional, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica protegida por lei aplicável.

title: Human Resources Supervisor
description:
Come Join our Family Today!

Together, We Make Travel Better!

O(a) Supervisor(a) de Recursos Humanos será o principal representante de RH na operação do Aeroporto de Viracopos, atuando como parceiro estratégico da liderança local e garantindo a execução eficaz dos processos de gestão de pessoas ao longo de toda a jornada do colaborador.

Esta posição exige um perfil fortemente generalista, capaz de conduzir atividades relacionadas a recrutamento e seleção, integração, treinamento, relações trabalhistas, gestão de desempenho, engajamento, compliance e rotinas administrativas de RH. O profissional atuará em parceria com as áreas corporativas especializadas de Folha de Pagamento, Benefícios, Total Rewards, Talent Acquisition e Learning & Development, sendo responsável pela execução local e pelo alinhamento às políticas e diretrizes corporativas.

O que buscamos

Business Partner e Suporte à Liderança

  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico dos gestores e equipes da operação.
  • Assessorar líderes em temas relacionados à gestão de pessoas, planejamento de força de trabalho, clima organizacional e desenvolvimento de equipes.
  • Orientar gestores em processos de avaliação de desempenho, feedback, desenvolvimento de talentos e questões disciplinares.
  • Promover uma experiência positiva para os colaboradores e fortalecer a cultura organizacional.

Recrutamento, Seleção e Integração

  • Conduzir processos de recrutamento e seleção para posições operacionais e de liderança local.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com a área corporativa de Talent Acquisition para garantir aderência às estratégias e padrões de contratação.
  • Coordenar o processo de onboarding e integração de novos colaboradores.
  • Apoiar o planejamento de mão de obra e contribuir para a redução do tempo de preenchimento das vagas.

Treinamento e Desenvolvimento

  • Coordenar a execução local dos programas de treinamento obrigatórios e de desenvolvimento.
  • Identificar necessidades de treinamento junto aos gestores.
  • Garantir o acompanhamento e controle dos treinamentos corporativos.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de desenvolvimento de liderança, sucessão e capacitação das equipes.

Relações Trabalhistas e Engajamento

  • Atuar na gestão de relações trabalhistas, conflitos, investigações internas e processos disciplinares, em conformidade com a legislação vigente e políticas da empresa.
  • Liderar ações de engajamento, reconhecimento e comunicação interna na unidade.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de gestão da mudança e projetos corporativos de RH.
  • Promover um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e alinhado aos valores da organização.

Operações de RH e Administração de Pessoal

  • Garantir o cumprimento da legislação trabalhista e das políticas internas.
  • Gerenciar documentação de colaboradores e atividades administrativas relacionadas ao ciclo de vida do empregado.
  • Apoiar processos de admissão, desligamento, movimentações internas, controle de jornada, férias e afastamentos.

  • Elaborar relatórios e análises para a liderança local e equipe corporativa de RH.

O que você precisará

title: Supervisor de Loja - Shopping Pátio Batel
description:
Descrição da vaga

Que tal entrar para o nosso ?

Aqui é lugar de gente que tem sede de vitória, é apaixonado por esporte, acredita no trabalho em equipe e está disposto a correr junto com os nossos clientes.

Esta convocação é para você, que tem garra e paixão por vencer e quer assumir uma posição peça-chave do nosso time, afinal, a loja tem que estar organizada para o jogo acontecer.

Sua missão será liderar e desenvolver a equipe de vendas, garantindo a excelência no atendimento e a performance comercial, de acordo com o posicionamento premium da loja. Atuar como elo entre a gerência e os consultores de vendas, impulsionando resultados e promovendo uma experiência diferenciada para o cliente.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Gestão de Equipe:
  • Acompanhar e direcionar a equipe de vendas no dia a dia.
  • Realizar feedbacks, orientar sobre técnicas de vendas e comportamento no atendimento.
  • Apoiar o processo de integração e treinamento de novos vendedores.
  • Gestão Comercial:
  • Monitorar indicadores como ticket médio, conversão e itens por atendimento.
  • Garantir que metas individuais e coletivas sejam atingidas.
  • Sugerir ações de vendas, campanhas e abordagens para diferentes perfis de clientes.
  • Atendimento ao Cliente:
  • Atuar no atendimento quando necessário, reforçando o padrão de excelência.
  • Resolver ocorrências e reclamações com rapidez e empatia.
  • Operacional:
  • Apoiar a organização e manutenção do layout e exposição dos produtos conforme o VM.
  • Garantir que a equipe siga os processos operacionais e políticas da loja.

Requisitos:

  • Formação: Ensino médio completo (superior em andamento é diferencial)
  • Conhecimentos: Técnicas de vendas, gestão de indicadores, CRM, pacote Office básico.
  • Diferenciais: Vivência em varejo premium ou esportivo, conhecimento em omnichannel.

Informações adicionais

SOBRE A CENTAURO

A Centauro é a maior empresa de artigos esportivos da América Latina. Nossa maior missão é mobilizar pessoas e transformar vidas por meio do esporte, por isso, nos orgulhamos da nossa trajetória, que iniciou em 1981 e resultou em nossas mais de 220 lojas, presentes em todas as regiões do Brasil.

Por aqui, cada jogada é ensaiada e nossos craques contam com técnicos, líderes de lojas e todas as ferramentas necessárias para uma visão estratégica de jogo!

O clima em loja é de descontração, mas quando chega a hora da partida, cada craque veste a camisa da sua posição e joga junto dos clientes. E se você precisar de ajuda, saiba que nosso time #jogaentrosado , afinal, aqui #miramosotopo.

Muito mais que uma loja, a Centauro é um lugar de histórias escritas por vencedores. Vem fazer seu nome, vem fazer parte do nosso #TimeDeCampeões!

SOBRE NÓS

Nós somos a Centauro, uma empresa do Grupo SBF.

Queremos ser reconhecidos na sociedade como a marca que movimenta o mercado esportivo para um novo patamar, contribuindo com o aumento da atividade física no Brasil. Estamos presentes em 26 estados, com 226 lojas próprias espalhadas pelo Brasil.

Somos convictos, acreditamos em mobilizar pessoas pela força da nossa essência.

Somos fazedores, acreditamos em mobilizar pessoas com ações práticas.

Somos saudavelmente inconformados, acreditamos em mobilizar pessoas a fazerem mais e melhor.

Somos criadores, acreditamos que sendo curiosos e tendo sede pelo novo, vamos criar o que ainda não foi feito.

Movimentar é o nosso esporte

title: Quality Manager
description:
About ROHA

From one small office in India in 1972 to a leading Multinational Company, engaged in Manufacture and Marketing of colors and food ingredients, ROHA today has offices in 22 countries, 14 technical application labs in many time zones globally. Manufacturing facilities are spread out across 14 countries: US, UK, Spain, Italy, India, South Africa, Vietnam, Indonesia, Thailand, China, Egypt, Brazil, Mexico & Australia. ROHA's products are marketed in more than 130 countries. Its portfolio includes natural extracts (oleoresins, juices and concentrates), an exclusive range of synthetic colors for the cosmetics and household goods industries, industrial colors, and animal feed additives.

We are hiring Quality Manager

Looking candidates from FOOD INDUSTRY ONLY

Candidates must be based in or near Itaquaquecetuba

Opportunity for Mid Management Level

5 days Working

Reporting to Regional Quality Manager

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage the Quality Assurance and Quality Control teams, including laboratory technicians.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain quality policies, procedures, and systems in accordance with GMP, HACCP, and food safety standards.
  • Ensure compliance with Brazilian and international regulatory requirements applicable to food color manufacturing.
  • Oversee testing of raw materials, in-process materials, and finished products.
  • Review and approve product specifications, raw material specifications, packaging specifications, Certificates of Analysis (COAs), and finished product releases.
  • Develop, review, and maintain laboratory Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and testing methodologies.
  • Monitor laboratory and production compliance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).
  • Manage preventive maintenance and calibration programs for laboratory equipment.
  • Investigate quality issues, identify root causes, and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
  • Partner with Production to troubleshoot process and quality-related issues.
  • Lead internal, customer, certification, and third-party audits, ensuring timely responses to audit findings.
  • Manage customer quality questionnaires and provide technical support and product application guidance.
  • Support new product development and identify opportunities for R&D projects.
  • Coordinate product recall activities when required.
  • Ensure all QA/QC documentation is complete, accurate, and compliant.
  • Develop, mentor, and train quality personnel while promoting a culture of continuous improvement.
  • Prepare quality metrics and reports for executive leadership.

title: Recepcionista
description:

A MBRAS valoriza diferentes trajetórias, perspectivas e experiências. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas com respeito, confidencialidade e critérios alinhados aos requisitos da posição.

title: Service Product Sales Engineer (Energy Storage)
description:
Summary

As an Overseas Service Sales Engineer, you will be responsible for promoting and selling the company's energy storage operation and maintenance service products in designated overseas markets. You will directly engage with end customers, channel partners, and project developers to drive the signing and execution of service contracts. A deep understanding of customer needs is essential to provide tailored solutions leveraging the company's service product strengths. You will collaborate closely with internal technical, project, and support teams to ensure customer success, contribute to achieving regional sales targets, and strengthen the company's competitiveness in the overseas energy storage services market.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Sales Target Execution & Client Development:
  2. 1.1. Execute team-defined regional service product sales strategies and action plans. Actively develop new clients and maintain existing client relationships to achieve individual sales targets (e.g., contract value, collection rate).
  3. 1.2. Independently manage the full sales cycle from opportunity identification, service requirement analysis, solution presentation, and negotiation to the signing of service contracts (e.g., LTSA, ASSA), with a focus on long-term service projects for energy storage plant O&M, operations, and asset management.
  4. Customer Insight & Solution Customization:
  5. 2.1. Conduct in-depth research on customer pain points, industry standards, and policy environments in key overseas target markets (e.g., Europe & Americas, APAC). Provide timely feedback on market trends and competitive intelligence.
  6. 2.2. Collaborate with the Solution Department to provide customers with suitable O&M service product portfolios (e.g., extended warranty, remote monitoring, preventive maintenance, performance optimization, assessment, supplementation). Lead technical discussions and service proposal presentations.
  7. Key Account & Channel Collaboration:
  8. 3.1. Assist the Sales Manager in maintaining relationships with regional strategic key accounts and channel partners. Participate in joint visits, technical workshops, and commercial negotiations.
  9. 3.2. Explore ecosystem partnership opportunities (e.g., with EPC contractors, energy operators) to expand service product coverage through partner networks.
  10. Cross-functional Collaboration & Project Support:
  11. 4.1. Work closely with Product, Project Management, Technical, and Service Delivery teams to ensure service solution feasibility. Facilitate smooth handover post-contract signing and track customer satisfaction.
  12. 4.2. Regularly relay customer feedback to internal teams, providing frontline input for service product optimization.
  13. Sales Process & Data Management:
  14. 5.1. Strictly utilize the CRM system to record sales activities, update pipeline data, and maintain customer information, ensuring forecast accuracy and process compliance.
  15. 5.2. Participate in team sales reviews. Analyze data to summarize win/loss experiences and market obstacles, supporting team strategy adjustments.
  16. Compliance & Risk Management:
  17. 6.1. Adhere to company overseas business compliance policies and local laws & regulations. Ensure contract terms and commercial activities meet risk control requirements. Promptly report potential risks.

Qualifications:

Must-to-Have:

  1. Bachelor's degree or higher. Engineering (Electrical, Energy, Automation, etc.) or Business background preferred.
  2. Minimum 3 years of B2B sales experience. Experience in service sales within new energy, energy storage, power, or industrial services preferred. Experience in overseas markets (especially Europe & Americas, Australia/New Zealand, Japan/Korea) is a plus.
  3. Familiarity with fundamental service technologies for energy storage systems, O&M/operations processes, or plant asset management models. Ability to communicate customer service needs effectively with technical teams.
  4. Proven track record of independently achieving sales targets. Practical experience in selling service-type products (e.g., subscription-based, long-term agreements) is required.
  5. Proficient in using CRM and office software; possesses basic data analysis skills.
  6. Fluent in English and Local Language (written and spoken). Knowledge of Chinese is a plus.

Soft Skills & Attributes:

  1. Customer-centric & Solution-oriented: Skilled at uncovering latent customer needs, translating product value into customer language, and providing targeted solutions.
  2. Self-driven & Resilient: Capable of proactively driving work in a goal-oriented, cross-time-zone collaborative environment. Maintains resilience under performance pressure.
  3. Cross-cultural Communication & Collaboration: Adapts to multicultural environments. Able to build trust and collaborate effectively with overseas clients and internal global teams.
  4. Learning & Adaptability: Stays attuned to changes in energy storage industry technology and business models. Quickly grasps new product and service logic.
  5. Integrity & Compliance Awareness: Upholds business ethics. Strictly adheres to company compliance processes, safeguarding the company's brand reputation.

Additional Notes:

  • This position requires frequent travel (approximately 30%-50% of the time) to cover designated overseas regional clients and project sites.
  • The company provides product training, sales methodology coaching, and overseas market resource support to facilitate employee growth.

title: Analista de comunicação sênior
description:
Responsável por apoiar a definição, estruturação e execução da estratégia e do Plano de Comunicação da Companhia, assegurando consistência, qualidade e alinhamento das comunicações internas e externas com o posicionamento institucional e os objetivos do negócio.

  • Acompanhar escopo, entregas, prazos, qualidade e desempenho dos prestadores;

A área de Tax Due Diligence atua na avaliação da situação tributária das empresas, principalmente em processos de fusões, aquisições (M&A) e reestruturações societárias. Seu principal objetivo é identificar riscos fiscais, contingências e oportunidades de otimização tributária, fornecendo informações estratégicas para apoiar a tomada de decisão dos clientes.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Gerenciar entregas e a comunicação com clientes e stakeholders, garantindo qualidade, agilidade e assertividade nos projetos;
  • Conduzir análises tributárias com foco em ICMS, ISS e IPI , identificando riscos, contingências e oportunidades de otimização tributária;
  • Realizar projetos de Tax Due Diligence , avaliando a situação fiscal de empresas em processos de aquisição, fusão e reestruturação societária;
  • Identificar riscos fiscais e pontos críticos relacionados aos tributos indiretos, incluindo revisão de apurações, obrigações acessórias e procedimentos fiscais;
  • Avaliar exposições tributárias e seus potenciais impactos financeiros para suportar negociações e tomadas de decisão;
  • Analisar benefícios fiscais, regimes especiais e incentivos tributários, bem como seus reflexos nas operações das empresas;
  • Elaborar relatórios de Due Diligence, memorandos técnicos e apresentações executivas com recomendações práticas e visão estratégica;
  • Apoiar clientes na mitigação de riscos tributários e na implementação de soluções relacionadas à tributação indireta;
  • Atuar em projetos multidisciplinares de M&A, reestruturações societárias e revisões tributárias, em conjunto com equipes de impostos, contabilidade, finanças e jurídico.

Requisitos / Qualificações

  • Excel em nível intermediário/avançado;
  • Superior completo em Ciências Contábeis ou Direito;
  • Sistemas Integrados de Gestão, Contabilidade Geral, Direito e Legislação Tributária;
  • Experiência especifica em impostos indiretos.

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em Power BI e aplicação prática de inteligência artificial no dia a dia serão considerados diferencias.
  • Pós-graduação, mestrado ou cursos de extensão em IFRS, finanças ou controladoria.
  • Experiência com clientes de capital aberto ou multinacionais.

Benefícios

title: Consultor Técnico Comercial - Instrumentos Médicos
description:
Nós somos a EssilorLuxottica, líder global no design, fabricação e distribuição de produtos avançados para cuidados com a visão, óculos e soluções de Med-Tech.

Nossa missão é Empowering Humans : empoderamos as pessoas por meio de tecnologias de lentes inovadoras, como Varilux, Stellest e Transitions; marcas icônicas como Ray-Ban, Oakley e Vogue Eyewear; as mais desejadas marcas licenciadas de luxo e bandeiras de varejo de classe mundial, como Sunglass Hut, GrandVision, Solaris e Óticas Carol.

A EssilorLuxottica está moldando um futuro no qual nossos olhos se tornam um poderoso portal de acesso capaz de elevar o potencial humano, revelar informações sobre a saúde e nos conectar com o mundo de maneiras completamente novas. Há gerações redefinimos os limites da visão, criando produtos de excelência, belos e de alto desempenho, que melhoram a visão valorizando a expressão pessoal.

Com mais de 200.000 colaboradores em 150 países, seguiremos elevando a forma como as pessoas veem o mundo, aproveitando nossos pontos fortes que vão da inovação med-tech ao diagnóstico, passando pelos wearables, IA e biometria, dando um significado mais profundo à saúde, ao bem-estar e às conexões.

Estamos em busca de um novo colaborador(a) para fazer parte da nossa equipe como Consultor Técnico Comercial - Instrumentos Médicos

Procuramos alguém com alta capacidade analítica, visão de negócio, domínio de ferramentas de dados e experiência consolidada em análise de rentabilidade e demonstrativos financeiros .

Dados, MIS e Governança da Informação:

- Participar ativamente da agenda de inovação e transformação digital da área financeira.

- Realizar análises de margem, rentabilidade e performance financeira do negócio e por vertical .

- Desenvolver análises de drivers financeiros e operacionais que impactam os resultados da companhia.

- Apoiar processos de orçamento, forecast e planejamento financeiro.

- Construir modelos analíticos para acompanhamento da rentabilidade de produtos, parceiros, canais e clientes.

- Elaborar apresentações executivas com recomendações baseadas em dados.

Interface com Áreas Parceiras

- Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções analíticas e financeiras.

- Administração

- Economia

- Engenharia

- Ciências Contábeis

- Estatística

- Matemática

- Áreas correlatas

Experiência

- Forte vivência com leitura de DRE e análise financeira.

- Experiência na estruturação e manutenção de bases de dados complexas.

- Vivência com automação de processos e geração de informações gerenciais.

- Experiência na construção de dashboards executivos e relatórios analíticos.

Hard Skills

Obrigatórios

Conhecimentos Financeiros

Soft Skills

Diferenciais

title: Analista de Comunicação Pleno (Marca)
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

title: HR Business Partner Manager
description:
ABOUT COTY

Coty is one of the world’s largest beauty companies, with an iconic portfolio of fragrance, color cosmetics, skincare, and body care brands. At Coty, we celebrate and nurture a culture of kindness. That’s why we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We believe that beauty lies in diversity and are committed to continuing to build an environment where all talents can thrive. We deeply value the unique contributions each individual brings to our team. As part of our commitment to inclusion, all profiles are welcome.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Act as a strategic HR partner for the Supporting Functions areas (Finance, IT, R&D, Procurement, Legal & Corporate Affairs) in Brazil, leading the execution of the people agenda aligned with the business strategy. In this role, you will consolidate information and guidelines at the regional level (LATAM) and connect with global stakeholders to ensure the alignment of organizational structures and talent management processes.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Business Partnering (Brazil – Main Focus)

  • Support Supporting Functions leaders in defining and executing the people strategy.
  • Translate business needs into tactical HR plans (short and medium-term).
  • Identify organizational risks and propose solutions regarding structure, people, and culture.
  • Act as a consultant on decisions related to organization, structure, and team sizing.

Organizational Structure Management

  • Lead organizational review processes, including restructuring, role design, and spans & layers.
  • Conduct analyses and propose structural changes, such as new roles and realignments.
  • Ensure all structural changes are aligned with regional and global guidelines for approvals.

Talent and Succession

  • Implement and monitor talent management cycles, including assessment, calibration, and succession planning.
  • Ensure the consistency and quality of performance and potential assessments.
  • Design development plans for key talents and critical successors.
  • Connect local agendas with global processes.
  • Design training and development programs for leadership.

Regional Interface (LATAM)

  • Consolidate Supporting Functions information across the region (Brazil, Argentina, Mexico, LDM).
  • Ensure consistency of HR criteria, processes, and metrics across LATAM.
  • Support the alignment of regional decisions based on data and analytics.
  • Collaborate with smaller markets to ensure adherence to guidelines while maintaining operational simplicity.

Global Interface

  • Act as the primary point of contact for the alignment of global HR processes.
  • Ensure strict adherence to global policies and frameworks.
  • Submit and defend proposed organizational changes for global approval.
  • Participate in global people and talent forums and projects.

HR Process and Project Management

  • Lead the implementation of core HR processes (performance, talent, succession, engagement, and culture).
  • Lead highly complex projects with cross-functional impact.
  • Ensure consistent execution and high-quality delivery of all HR processes.

Core Responsibilities Summary

  • Strategic Business Partnering.
  • Organizational Structure Management.
  • Cultural Management.
  • Development Programs.
  • Employee Life Cycle Management.
  • Global and Regional Interface.

REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS

Technical Skills & Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree completed.
  • Solid experience in Human Resources, preferably in an HR Business Partner (HRBP) role.
  • Strong knowledge of HR processes, including Talent, Performance, Succession, and Organizational Design.
  • Proven experience in organizational design and structural management.
  • Strong analytical capacity (people analytics and insights).
  • Experience working in a regional and multicultural environment.
  • Experience conducting and managing development programs.
  • Advanced/Fluent English (mandatory).
  • Spanish is desirable.

Behavioral Skills:

  • Strong influence and stakeholder management skills (including global stakeholders).
  • Strategic vision combined with practical execution.
  • Clear and assertive communication.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and manage multiple demands simultaneously.
  • Solid change management skills.

description:
Quem somos nós

Empresa líder na indústria de energia elétrica no continente americano, com mais de 50 anos de experiência na criação de soluções integradas para atender às necessidades de geração, transmissão e distribuição de energia elétrica.

Key Responsibilities

Lead international transport operations for heavy and oversized cargo, primarily destined for the United States;

Plan and coordinate multimodal operations involving road, maritime, rail, and/or river transport;

Manage carriers, freight forwarders, cargo agents, port terminals, customs brokers, and other partners;

Coordinate inbound and outbound logistics operations for raw materials, components, and finished goods, ensuring compliance with internal standards and procedures while meeting the requirements of internal and external customers.

Manage all stages of international logistics (import and export), overseeing shipment, customs clearance, and delivery processes to ensure adherence to deadlines, cost targets, and quality standards.

Plan, negotiate, contract, and manage domestic and international transportation services (road, sea, and air), covering everything from dispatch to delivery to the final customer.

Develop, monitor, and ensure adherence to the freight and transportation budget, seeking cost-reduction opportunities without compromising service levels.

Monitor logistics performance indicators, proposing and implementing continuous improvement actions to boost operational efficiency.

Manage and evaluate the performance of transportation providers and logistics operators, developing new strategic partnerships to meet business demands.

Ensure logistics processes comply with current legislation, foreign trade regulations, and quality requirements.

Oversee the maintenance and development of the AEO (Authorized Economic Operator) program, ensuring compliance with program requirements and contributing to the security of the international logistics supply chain.

Lead the logistics team, fostering employee development, driving results, and promoting continuous process improvement.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Foreign Trade, Logistics, Engineering, or related fields.

Experience in domestic and international logistics (import and export).

Experience negotiating domestic and international freight rates.

Knowledge of Incoterms, customs regulations, and foreign trade.

Experience with the AEO (Authorized Economic Operator) program.

Knowledge of logistics KPIs and cost management.

Fluent English.

Experience leading teams.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or above in Engineering, Business Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain Management , or a related field.

  • Previous experience supervising or coordinating logistics or warehouse operations.
  • Strong problem-solving and data analysis skills , with the ability to interpret operational data and make sound, data-driven decisions.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with customers, peers, direct reports, and cross-functional stakeholders .
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, managing multiple priorities while maintaining operational excellence.

Preferred Qualifications

title: AI Operations
description:
About Liora

Liora is an energy fintech: we operate distributed generation assets across Brazil and turn the savings they generate on clients' electricity bills into financial products, credit, cashback and benefits, without increasing what clients pay.

Most people treat their electricity bill as a fixed, unavoidable cost, something you pay and forget.

What they don't realize is that energy has all the characteristics of a financial asset: it's recurring, predictable, and present in virtually every household and business budget. Liora was built on that insight.

The electricity bill stops being a burden and becomes a channel for economic opportunity, especially for the small businesses that traditional finance has always underserved.

We're building an AI-first operation where agents score credit & risk, approve or decline applications, and run ownership transfers across dozens of energy distributors.

This is not an automation project. It is a real business operation with real clients, real volume and real consequences, designed from day one to be run by AI agents.

We are looking for the person who will make it work.

What you'll operate

Credit & Risk

Deciding who is a good payer, who is too risky, and under what terms we should accept each client.

  • Define and apply credit & risk criteria: evaluate payment behavior, energy consumption and other signals to determine approval, limits and risk.
  • Run and improve the operation:m onitor decisions, portfolio health, default rates and edge cases, turning learnings into better rules and processes.
  • Own the AI agents: define how they analyze applications, what they handle autonomously and where they escalate to you.

Ownership Transfer

Getting every new consumer unit (UC) fully switched over to Liora across dozens of distributors with different rules and systems.

  • Own the process: map distributor requirements and ensure contracts and documentation are correct.
  • Run and unblock the operation: track transfers, resolve rejections and exceptions, and keep applications moving.
  • Own the AI agents: automate execution, define escalation points and continuously expand what agents can handle.

These are complex, high-volume operations that, in the traditional model, would require large teams. At Liora, we want them run by agents, with you in command.

Who you are

We care less about titles and years of experience than about how you think, learn and solve problems.

You don't need to have done this before. Very few people have. We're looking for someone early enough in their career to be excited by building something from scratch, but ambitious enough to take real ownership from day one.

Degree and industry background don't matter. What matters is that you can move between business judgment and technical execution: understand the problem, build the solution, measure the result and improve it.

You're not waiting for a defined process or formal training to get started. You enjoy figuring things out when there is no obvious answer.

You spend time experimenting with AI agents because you're genuinely curious. You've tested tools, broken things, understood why they broke and tried again.

Why now, why Liora

The energy sector is full of opaque tariffs, fragmented processes and decades of accumulated complexity. Liora is turning that complexity into financial infrastructure for SMBs and high-consumption consumers.

We're backed by Canary, 17Sigma and 468 Capital. We doubled in size in the first two months of 2026 and project 15x growth by year end.

You'll join while the category is being created, with the autonomy to build the playbook as you go.

The window is open. It won't stay that way forever.
